properties.name: Nuka-World
properties.basis: fan theory: the park's ground matches the Connecticut River valley south of Springfield
properties.note: Nuka-World is its own worldspace, off the Commonwealth map. The game says only that it is in Massachusetts, west of Boston, reached by the Nuka-Express monorail from the transit center at the map's western edge, and that the line comes into the park from the northeast. A fan theory places it south of Springfield on the Connecticut River, because three things in the park's world match the ground there: a real theme park (Six Flags New England), a north–south river with an island, and a north–south interstate (I-91). That puts it in Agawam, right by the Connecticut line. A straight line from the transit center to Agawam would arrive from the east-northeast, close enough to fit. The game confirms none of this; Bethesda never named a site.
sources: Nexus Mods 93005: the Connecticut River theory

properties.name: Road route to Nuka-World (fastest drive)
properties.basis: fastest drive from the transit center's real position, routed by OSRM on OpenStreetMap roads and simplified to about 400 m: the Mass Pike (I-90) west, I-291 into Springfield, then MA 57 across the Connecticut River to Agawam
